metadata.title: Use blocking Redis pool under connection pressure
metadata.author: Genmin

description:
## Summary
- create the shared async Redis client with `BlockingConnectionPool` so bursts wait briefly for an available pooled connection instead of failing immediately at `max_connections`
- add configurable `REDIS_POOL_TIMEOUT` with a conservative default and document it in `.env.example`
- close the explicit pool on shutdown and update Redis client unit coverage around pool construction, parser forwarding, caching, and close behavior

Fixes #4570.

## Validation
- `uv run ruff check mcpgateway/utils/redis_client.py mcpgateway/config.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_redis_client.py`
- `uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_redis_client.py -q`
